title: Feasibility study of using magnetic and thermoelectric methods for the assessment of storage-induced changes in flux-cored welding wires
authors: Aleksandra Świerczyńska, Balázs Varbai, Leszek Piotrowski
abstract: The lack of knowledge regarding whether a welding consumable remains suitable for the welding process or has undergone degradation that precludes its further use constitutes a significant challenge. Appropriate control procedures and effective evaluation methods may contribute to addressing this issue. This study presents the results of investigations concerning the applicability of magnetic and thermoelectric methods for such an assessment. Rutile flux-cored welding wires were stored in four different locations and subsequently collected for testing after 3, 6, and 12 months. Their suitability for industrial application was initially assessed on the basis of visual examination. Subsequently, measurements of thermoelectric power, characterization of bulk magnetic properties, and Magnetic Barkhausen Noise (MBN) were performed for each wire. Visual inspection confirmed the good surface condition of the wires despite the exceedance of the recommended limits of temperature and relative humidity during storage. The thermoelectric measurements showed that storage environment significantly affects the Seebeck Coefficient (SC) of welding wires, with marine conditions inducing rapid changes and less aggressive environments producing a gradual time dependent increase. Magnetic property measurements indicated that two of the evaluated parameters, namely the amplitude of MBN and the area under the envelopes of MBN, exhibited changes with storage time at each exposure site. Statistical analysis demonstrated that the parameters recorded during magnetic and thermoelectric measurements were characterized by a high degree of correlation, exceeding 0.9 in some cases. A strong linear relationship between the MBN Amplitude-to-Envelope Ratio and SC was observed for wires stored in the Urban Area and Workshop environments (r = 0.99 for both), indicating a close correlation between the evolution of their thermoelectric and magnetic properties during storage. This finding indicates the potential applicability of these methods for the detection of changes occurring in flux-cored wires during storage.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a practical non-destructive way to screen consumable wire condition before welding, helping avoid use of degraded material in production.

infographic.watch_item: The results are based on a limited set of storage sites and times, so broader validation is needed before routine industrial adoption.

zh-Hans.title: 利用磁性和热电方法评估药芯焊丝储存诱导变化的可行性研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 关于某种焊接耗材是否仍适用于焊接过程，还是已经发生劣化而不再适合继续使用，相关知识的缺乏构成了一个重大挑战。适当的控制程序和有效的评估方法可能有助于解决这一问题。本研究给出了关于磁性和热电方法用于此类评估的适用性研究结果。钛型药芯焊丝被储存在四个不同地点，并分别在3个月、6个月和12个月后取样进行测试。首先依据外观检查评估其工业应用适用性。随后，对每种焊丝进行了热电势测量、体磁性能表征以及磁巴克豪森噪声（MBN）测量。尽管储存期间温度和相对湿度超出了推荐限值，目视检查仍证实这些焊丝表面状况良好。热电测量表明，储存环境会显著影响焊丝的塞贝克系数（SC），其中海洋环境会引起快速变化，而侵蚀性较弱的环境则导致随时间逐渐增加。磁性能测量表明，所评估的两个参数，即MBN幅值和MBN包络线下面积，在各暴露地点均随储存时间发生变化。统计分析显示，磁性和热电测量中记录的参数具有很高的相关性，在某些情况下超过0.9。在城市区域和车间环境中储存的焊丝上，MBN幅值-包络线比与SC之间观察到强线性关系（两者r = 0.99），表明其热电与磁性能在储存过程中的演变高度相关。这一发现表明，这些方法在检测药芯焊丝储存过程中发生的变化方面具有潜在适用性。

infographic.key_insight: 磁巴克豪森噪声和热电测量可检测药芯焊丝因储存引起的变化，关键信号之间具有很强一致性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这提供了一种在焊接前筛查耗材焊丝状态的实用无损方法，有助于避免在生产中使用劣化材料。
method: 将钛型药芯焊丝在四种环境中储存3个月、6个月和12个月
评估外观状态、塞贝克系数和体磁性能
测量磁巴克豪森噪声参数，并将其与热电数据进行统计比较
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了磁性与热电指标之间的强相关性，包括在两个环境中MBN幅值-包络线比与塞贝克系数之间r = 0.99。
infographic.watch_item: 该结果基于有限的储存地点和时间点，因此在常规工业应用前仍需更广泛验证。

title: Optimization of Friction Stir Welding Parameters for Improving the Mechanical Properties of Aluminum Alloy Joints
authors: Pompy Pratisna, Ferdy Hendarto Susilo, Sutikno Wahyu Hidayat, Dedy Aryanto
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) performance depends on the interaction among processing parameters rather than individual operating conditions. This study examined the effects of rotational speed (800, 1000, and 1200 rpm), travel speed (40, 60, and 80 mm/min), and axial force (4, 6, and 8 kN) on the mechanical properties of 6-mm AA6061-T6 butt joints. A 3 × 3 × 3 full factorial design with three reported replicates per condition yielded 81 mechanical-test observations, covering ultimate tensile strength (UTS), yield strength, elongation, and hardness. Factorial analysis of variance (ANOVA) and coded quadratic regression were performed using IBM SPSS Statistics 31. All three parameters showed significant main effects across the four mechanical responses (p < .001), while the Rotation × Travel interaction was significant for each response. Rotational speed exhibited the largest partial effect size for UTS (partial η² = .807). The quadratic regression models explained 72.1%–84.6% of the response variance and identified 1200 rpm, 80 mm/min, and 8 kN as the highest-predicted UTS setting among the 27 evaluated combinations, with a predicted UTS of 280.39 MPa and a calculated joint efficiency of 90.45%. These findings demonstrate the importance of considering parameter interactions when selecting FSW operating conditions, while limiting the model-based recommendation to the investigated material, tool configuration, and experimental range.
venue: Journal of Renewable Energy and Smart Device

infographic.key_insight: FSW joint performance is governed by strong interactions among rotational speed, travel speed, and axial force, not by any single parameter alone.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For AA6061-T6 butt joints, tuning the process window can substantially improve strength and efficiency, with the best tested condition reaching an estimated 280.39 MPa UTS and 90.45% joint efficiency.

zh-Hans.title: 优化搅拌摩擦焊参数以提升铝合金接头力学性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）性能取决于加工参数之间的相互作用，而非单个操作条件。本研究考察了转速（800、1000 和 1200 rpm）、行进速度（40、60 和 80 mm/min）以及轴向力（4、6 和 8 kN）对 6 mm AA6061-T6 对接接头力学性能的影响。采用 3 × 3 × 3 全因子设计，并在每种条件下报告 3 次重复，共获得 81 个力学测试观测值，涵盖抗拉强度（UTS）、屈服强度、伸长率和硬度。使用 IBM SPSS Statistics 31 进行了因子方差分析（ANOVA）和编码二次回归。三项参数在四个力学响应上均表现出显著主效应（p < .001），同时 Rotation × Travel 交互作用对每个响应均显著。对于 UTS，转速表现出最大的部分效应量（partial η² = .807）。二次回归模型解释了 72.1%–84.6% 的响应方差，并在所评估的 27 种组合中确定 1200 rpm、80 mm/min 和 8 kN 为预测 UTS 最高的设置，预测 UTS 为 280.39 MPa，计算得到的接头效率为 90.45%。这些结果表明，在选择 FSW 操作条件时考虑参数交互作用十分重要，但基于模型的推荐仅适用于所研究的材料、工具配置和实验范围。

infographic.key_insight: FSW 接头性能受转速、行进速度和轴向力之间强交互作用支配，而非仅由任何单一参数决定。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于 AA6061-T6 对接接头，通过调节工艺窗口可显著提升强度和效率，其中最佳测试条件的估计 UTS 可达 280.39 MPa，接头效率为 90.45%。

infographic.watch_item: 推荐参数为基于模型的结果，且在所测试的工具、材料和参数范围之外应谨慎使用。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A combined CEL simulation and ANN workflow can accurately predict temperature, force, and defect formation in friction stir welding of HDPE, enabling fast identification of weld-quality windows.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical process guidance for improving thermoplastic weld quality by tuning rotational speed, travel speed, and bottom preheating to reduce defects and stabilize axial forces.
method: 3D Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of FSW under varied process settings
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental time-series data
Process-map generation to separate defect-free from defective welding conditions
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved strong predictive performance with R2 values of 0.91 to 0.99, and the CEL results matched experiments for temperatures, forces, and void formation.
infographic.watch_item: The models are validated on a limited parameter space, so performance may drop when extrapolated to new tool designs, material grades, or wider operating ranges.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯摩擦搅拌焊焊缝质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 摩擦搅拌焊（FSW）已被公认为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究采用计算方法与机器学习方法，并结合实验结果验证，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）摩擦搅拌焊中的焊缝温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等FSW特征进行预测，开展了系统性研究。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于在不同工艺参数——转速、焊接速度以及底部预热条件——下模拟HDPE焊接过程。该CEL数值模型通过实验数据验证，在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，底部表面预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定竖向力波动。定量而言，底部表面在60 °C预热时，最大压入力从接近1600 N降至约1100 N，峰值温度则从70 °C（无预热）升至约100 °C，从而平滑了厚度方向梯度并稳定了轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力的时序响应，其R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有很高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊接区形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；然而，CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图谱，突出显示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm和30 mm/min、并采用60 °C预热时获得最佳条件，而在1000 rpm且无预热条件下由于虫孔形成而表现出较差的可焊性。这些发现为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指导，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合CEL仿真与ANN的工作流程能够准确预测HDPE摩擦搅拌焊中的温度、力和缺陷形成，从而快速识别焊接质量窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究通过调整转速、行进速度和底部预热来减少缺陷并稳定轴向力，为改善热塑性材料焊接质量提供了实用的工艺指导。
method: 在不同工艺设定下建立FSW的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
基于实验时间序列数据训练两个多层感知机ANN
生成工艺图谱以区分无缺陷与有缺陷的焊接条件
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型取得了很强的预测性能，R2值为0.91至0.99，且CEL结果在温度、力和孔洞形成方面与实验相符。
infographic.watch_item: 这些模型仅在有限参数空间内得到验证，因此当外推到新的工具设计、材料牌号或更宽的运行范围时，性能可能下降。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.key_insight: A spray distance of 190 mm produced the densest Cr3C2–NiCr coating and the best corrosion resistance on DSS 2205 in 1 M H2SO4.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Tuning D-gun spray distance is a practical way to improve coating integrity and extend the life of stainless steel components in acidic service.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Evaluated electrochemical behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
Compared coating microstructure and porosity by SEM/analysis.
infographic.evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, and the 190 mm coating showed the lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy) versus 2.60 mmpy for uncoated DSS 2205.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum distance is specific to this powder/substrate/electrolyte setup, so it should be revalidated for different spray parameters or service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments

zh-Hans.title: 喷涂距离对酸性环境中D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层在DSS 2205上的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层兼具陶瓷的高硬度和金属的韧性，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂（D-gun spraying）是最具发展前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2-NiCr涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀特性而具有应用价值。采用1 M H2SO4在严苛酸性条件下评估了D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的有效性；该溶液作为标准化实验室电解质，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性，其中包括喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，而喷涂距离对孔隙率、结合强度、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定至关重要。采用Cr3C2-NiCr在三个喷涂距离下对双相不锈钢（DSS）2205进行喷涂；分别为170 mm、180 mm和190 mm，以研究Cr3C2-NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下对1 M H2SO4溶液中的涂层电化学活性进行了评估。SEM下的表面形貌研究显示，涂层致密且呈层状结构，孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔化程度和涂层致密性得到提高。190 mm沉积的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，其腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），相比之下未涂覆基体为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀且致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是制备DSS 2205上高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在严苛酸性工业环境中运行的部件提供更强的耐腐蚀保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺-微观结构-性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提高严苛酸性环境下的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 190 mm的喷涂距离在1 M H2SO4中在DSS 2205上形成了最致密的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层，并表现出最佳耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 调节D-gun喷涂距离是提高涂层完整性、延长不锈钢部件在酸性服役环境中寿命的实用方法。
method: 以170、180和190 mm的距离将D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂覆于DSS 2205上。
采用OCP、EIS和动电位极化在1 M H2SO4中评估电化学行为。
通过SEM/分析比较涂层微观结构和孔隙率。
infographic.evidence_signal: 孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，且190 mm涂层的腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆DSS 2205为2.60 mmpy。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳距离针对该粉末/基体/电解质组合而定，因此在不同喷涂参数或服役环境下应重新验证。

title: Machine learning-based prediction formulas for buckling resistance of welding-strengthened circular steel tubes
authors: Jiafeng Lyu, Su Yan, Shen Yan, Shen Yan, Shen Yan, Xianzhong Zhao
abstract: Welding curved cover plates is commonly used to strengthen circular hollow section (CHS) members under service loads, but welding heat input can induce lateral deflection and complex post-strengthening stress states that reduce the buckling resistance. This study develops machine-learning (ML)-based prediction models and a practical buckling-resistance prediction formula for such members. A database of 800 finite-element (FE) samples, derived from 400 structural configurations, was generated using validated sequentially coupled thermo-mechanical analyses covering service loading, welding, cooling, and post-strengthening loading. K-nearest neighbours (KNN), adaptive boosting (AdaBoost), artificial neural networks (ANN), and deep and cross networks (DCN) were trained to predict the stability factor, welding-induced deflection amplification factor, and post-strengthening compressive stress level. Among them, DCN showed the best overall performance, with test-set R 2 values exceeding 0.992 for all three targets. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) identified post-strengthening normalised slenderness ( λ ns ), service load level ( α p ), the diameter-to-cover-plate-thickness ratio (2 γ s ), and original-member yield strength ( f y0 ) as the governing features. Higher α p and lower 2 γ s and f y0 increased deformation and compressive stress, thereby reducing buckling resistance. Based on these relationships, an explicit resistance prediction formula was established by combining a service-load-induced resistance reduction factor with column-curve selection criteria. The proposed formula achieved a mean predicted-to-FE resistance ratio of 0.952 and a MAPE of 6.03%, outperforming an existing semi-empirical model and code provisions.

infographic.key_insight: Machine-learning models, especially DCN, can accurately predict buckling resistance of welding-strengthened circular steel tubes and help turn complex thermo-mechanical effects into a practical design formula.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a deployable resistance prediction approach for strengthening CHS members, improving design reliability when welding-induced distortion and residual stress would otherwise be difficult to account for.

zh-Hans.title: 基于机器学习的焊接加劲圆钢管屈曲承载力预测公式
zh-Hans.abstract: 焊接弧形盖板常用于对服役荷载作用下的圆形空心截面（CHS）构件进行加劲，但焊接热输入会引起侧向挠度和复杂的加劲后应力状态，从而降低屈曲承载力。本研究针对此类构件开发了基于机器学习（ML）的预测模型和一种实用的屈曲承载力预测公式。研究基于经验证的顺序耦合热-力分析，在覆盖服役加载、焊接、冷却和加劲后加载全过程的条件下，由400种结构构型生成了800个有限元（FE）样本数据库。采用K近邻（KNN）、自适应提升（AdaBoost）、人工神经网络（ANN）和深度交叉网络（DCN）对稳定系数、焊接诱导挠度放大系数以及加劲后压应力水平进行训练预测。其中，DCN表现出最佳的整体性能，对三个目标在测试集上的R2值均超过0.992。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）识别出加劲后归一化长细比（λns）、服役荷载水平（αp）、直径与盖板厚度比（2γs）以及原始构件屈服强度（fy0）是主导特征。较高的αp以及较低的2γs和fy0会增加变形和压应力，从而降低屈曲承载力。基于这些关系，通过结合服役荷载引起的承载力折减系数与柱曲线选取准则，建立了一个显式承载力预测公式。所提出的公式得到的预测值与FE承载力之比的平均值为0.952，MAPE为6.03%，优于现有半经验模型和规范规定。

infographic.key_insight: 机器学习模型，尤其是DCN，能够准确预测焊接加劲圆钢管的屈曲承载力，并有助于将复杂的热-力效应转化为实用的设计公式。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为加劲CHS构件提供了一种可部署的承载力预测方法，可在焊接诱导变形和残余应力难以计入时提升设计可靠性。

训练KNN、AdaBoost、ANN和DCN模型，以预测稳定系数、挠度放大和加劲后压应力。

title: Automated Complex for the Reclamation and Anti-Corrosion Protection of Steel Marine Propellers via Supersonic Cold Gas-Dynamic Spraying Utilizing AI-Driven Control
authors: Alexandr Kuzmin
abstract: This paper presents the technological concept and architecture of a robotic manufacturing system (RMS) designed for the precision reclamation and long-term anti-corrosion protection of steel marine propellers utilized in sea-going and river vessels. The proposed method integrates cold gas-dynamic spraying (CGDS) technology with a 6-axis industrial manipulator equipped with an artificial intelligence (AI)-based computer vision system and an automatic tool changer (ATC). This technology mitigates the issues of cavitational and electrochemical degradation of propeller blades by introducing an adaptive manufacturing cycle. This cycle encompasses contactless 3D defect mapping, abrasive preparation, supersonic spraying of functional coatings, and force-controlled (Force-Torque) adaptive finish grinding. This comprehensive approach eliminates thermal distortion of the treated component, minimizes hydrodynamic drag, and extends the operational lifespan of the protective coating by a factor of 4–5 compared to conventional techniques. Furthermore, the economic viability of implementing this technology is evaluated, with a specific focus on the on-site repair of ultra-large vessels (supertankers) without the need for propeller disassembly.Keywords: Cold gas-dynamic spraying, robot manipulator, artificial intelligence, computer vision, marine propeller, cavitation erosion, adaptive grinding, supertankers.

zh-Hans.title: 利用AI驱动控制的超音速冷气动力喷涂实现钢制海洋螺旋桨修复与防腐保护的自动化复合系统
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文提出了一种机器人制造系统（RMS）的技术概念与架构，该系统旨在对海轮和内河船舶所使用的钢制海洋螺旋桨进行高精度修复与长期防腐保护。所提出的方法将冷气动力喷涂（CGDS）技术与配备基于人工智能（AI）的计算机视觉系统及自动换刀装置（ATC）的六轴工业机械臂相结合。该技术通过引入自适应制造循环，缓解螺旋桨叶片的空化和电化学退化问题。该循环包括非接触式三维缺陷建模、磨料预处理、功能涂层的超音速喷涂以及基于力控制（Force-Torque）的自适应精磨。该综合方法可消除被处理部件的热变形，降低流体动力阻力，并使防护涂层的服役寿命相较传统技术延长4–5倍。此外，本文评估了该技术实施的经济可行性，重点关注超大型船舶（supertankers）无需拆卸螺旋桨即可进行现场修复。关键词：冷气动力喷涂，机器人机械臂，人工智能，计算机视觉，船用螺旋桨，空蚀磨损，自适应磨削，超大型船舶。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr coatings, higher-velocity spray processes produced denser, harder coatings with better wear and corrosion performance than atmospheric plasma spraying.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear- and corrosion-critical components, HVOF and HVAF emerge as the strongest coating choices on 304 stainless steel in this study.
method: Prepared WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel using APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, hardness, wear behavior, and electrochemical corrosion resistance.
Ranked performance across spray routes to identify the best process windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness increased from 771.4 HV (APS) to about 1166 HV (HVOF/HVAF), while wear rate dropped from 36.82×10^-5 mm3/N·m for bare steel to 1.10–1.17×10^-5 for HVOF/HVAF coatings; HVAF also showed the best corrosion metrics.
infographic.watch_item: Results are process- and parameter-dependent, so the reported ranking may shift with spray settings, substrate condition, or service environment.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性与耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐蚀性。分别采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度均高于304不锈钢，分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率均低于304不锈钢，分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5和(1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主要相，因此后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层。此外，HVOF和HVAF涂层表现出更好的耐磨性能。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）以及最大的耐蚀性（20438.5 Ω）。在这四种涂层中，APS涂层的耐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层中，更高速度的喷涂工艺可制备出更致密、更硬的涂层，其耐磨和耐蚀性能均优于大气等离子喷涂。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨和耐蚀关键部件，本研究表明HVOF和HVAF是在304不锈钢上最优的涂层选择。
method: 采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上制备WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较显微组织、硬度、磨损行为和电化学耐蚀性。
对不同喷涂路线的性能进行排序，以确定最佳工艺窗口。
infographic.evidence_signal: 硬度从771.4 HV（APS）提高到约1166 HV（HVOF/HVAF），而磨损率则从裸钢的36.82×10^-5 mm3/N·m降至HVOF/HVAF涂层的1.10–1.17×10^-5 mm3/N·m；HVAF还表现出最佳的耐蚀指标。
infographic.watch_item: 结果受工艺和参数影响，因此所报告的排序可能随喷涂参数、基体状态或服役环境而变化。

title: Explainable machine learning approach for predicting mechanical characteristics of AA6082–AA7075 friction stir welded joints
authors: K. Giridharan, K. Thavasilingam, D Srinivasan, RM Sakthi Sadhasivam, M Vinothkumar, D Manikandan
abstract: This study presents an effective Machine Learning (ML)-based framework for predicting the mechanical properties of Friction Stir Welded (FSW) joints using key welding parameters. Tool Rotational Speed (TRS), Traverse Speed (TTS), and Tool Plunge Depth (TPD) were considered as input variables, while Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) and micro-hardness were selected as output responses. Experimental data were used to develop and evaluate five regression models: Linear Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). Model performance was assessed using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Relative Absolute Error (RAE), and Root Relative Squared Error (RRSE) with an 80:20 training–testing split. Among the developed models, ensemble learning techniques demonstrated superior predictive capability for UTS. The Random Forest model achieved the best performance with the lowest testing MAE and RMSE values of 9.007 MPa and 12.975 MPa, respectively, while XGBoost also showed strong prediction accuracy. For micro-hardness prediction, SVR with a radial basis function kernel produced the highest accuracy, with MAE and RMSE values of 0.923 HV and 1.155 HV, respectively. Experimental validation confirmed that optimized welding conditions of 900 rpm rotational speed, 20 mm/min traverse speed, and 4.89 mm plunge depth significantly enhanced weld performance, resulting in a UTS of 281 MPa, micro-hardness of 138.4 HV, and refined nugget zone grain size of approximately 7 μm. The findings demonstrate that ML-driven approaches provide reliable prediction and optimization of FSW properties supporting intelligent manufacturing and potentially contributing to more efficient welding process design for sustainable applications.

infographic.key_insight: Machine learning can accurately predict and optimize the tensile strength and micro-hardness of AA6082–AA7075 friction stir welded joints from key welding parameters.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a fast surrogate model for selecting welding conditions, helping improve weld quality and reduce trial-and-error in intelligent manufacturing.

Compared LR, RF, SVR, XGBoost, and KNN on experimental FSW data
Used an 80:20 train-test split with MAE, RMSE, RAE, and RRSE
infographic.evidence_signal: Random Forest gave the best UTS prediction on testing data (MAE 9.007 MPa, RMSE 12.975 MPa), while SVR with RBF kernel performed best for micro-hardness (MAE 0.923 HV, RMSE 1.155 HV).
infographic.watch_item: The model performance is based on a relatively limited experimental dataset, so broader validation is needed before deployment across other alloys or tool geometries.

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测AA6082–AA7075搅拌摩擦焊接接头力学特性的可解释机器学习方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究提出了一个基于机器学习（ML）的有效框架，利用关键焊接参数预测搅拌摩擦焊接（FSW）接头的力学性能。将工具旋转速度（TRS）、焊接行进速度（TTS）和工具压入深度（TPD）作为输入变量，并选取极限抗拉强度（UTS）和显微硬度作为输出响应。采用实验数据建立并评估了五种回归模型：线性回归（LR）、随机森林（RF）、支持向量回归（SVR）、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）和K近邻（KNN）。采用80:20训练—测试划分，并使用平均绝对误差（MAE）、均方根误差（RMSE）、相对绝对误差（RAE）和根相对平方误差（RRSE）评估模型性能。在所开发的模型中，集成学习技术在UTS预测方面表现出更优的预测能力。随机森林模型表现最佳，其测试集MAE和RMSE最低，分别为9.007 MPa和12.975 MPa，而XGBoost也显示出较强的预测精度。对于显微硬度预测，采用径向基函数核的SVR取得了最高准确性，其MAE和RMSE分别为0.923 HV和1.155 HV。实验验证表明，优化后的焊接条件为900 rpm旋转速度、20 mm/min行进速度和4.89 mm压入深度，显著提升了焊接性能，使UTS达到281 MPa、显微硬度达到138.4 HV，并使焊核区晶粒尺寸细化至约7 μm。研究结果表明，机器学习驱动的方法能够为FSW性能提供可靠的预测与优化，支持智能制造，并有望为可持续应用中更高效的焊接工艺设计做出贡献。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC on SA516 boiler steel formed the most protective oxide scale and gave the strongest high-temperature oxidation resistance, cutting weight gain by 95.71% versus uncoated steel.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For boiler and high-temperature service, the study shows that combining Ni-Cr coatings with TiC reinforcement and HVOF processing can substantially improve durability against cyclic oxidation and spalling.
method: Applied Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings on SA516 steel using HVOF and plasma spray.
Ran 50 cyclic air-oxidation cycles at 900°C to compare oxidation resistance.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF和等离子喷涂SA516锅炉钢上Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的显微组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，研究了涂覆Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN的SA516锅炉钢的显微组织及高温氧化行为。在模拟实验室环境中，于900°C下进行了50个循环的空气氧化试验，并通过X射线衍射（XRD）、配有能量色散光谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）以及X射线面分布分析对所得显微组织和相变进行了分析。未涂层SA516钢发生了严重的氧化层剥落和开裂，形成了未受保护的相（Fe 2 O 3 ）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层相较于裸SA516钢将最大增重量降低了95.71%，表明其具有更优异的抗氧化性。这种增强的涂层性能归因于形成了致密的保护性氧化层，该氧化层由Cr 2 O 3 、TiO 2 、NiTiO 4 和NiO组成，同时伴随着孔隙率降低和显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: 在SA516锅炉钢上，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC形成了最具保护性的氧化膜，并表现出最强的高温抗氧化性，相较于未涂层钢，增重量降低了95.71%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于锅炉和高温服役应用，该研究表明，将Ni-Cr涂层与TiC增强相结合并采用HVOF工艺，可显著提高材料对循环氧化和剥落的耐久性。

在900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化，以比较抗氧化性能。
使用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线面分布分析对相和显微组织进行表征。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, higher laser power and current strengthen molten-pool convection and penetration, while higher travel speed reduces heat input and narrows the weld.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results help tune hybrid welding parameters to improve weld quality and arc stability when joining low-thermal-expansion Invar components for aerospace tooling.

High-speed photography of arc and pool morphology evolution
Parametric study of laser power, welding speed, and current

infographic.watch_item: The findings are parameter-window specific, so transferring them to different joint geometries, thicknesses, or equipment may require recalibration.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺层面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本文采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支撑。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增加会导致更大的回弹压力，从而促进更大的熔深和小孔尺寸，增强整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更易受到激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，较高的速度降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，在高速度下电弧更易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增加增强了电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，在高电流下电弧更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，较高的激光功率和电流会增强熔池对流和熔深，而较高的行进速度会降低热输入并使焊缝变窄。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果有助于优化复合焊接参数，以提高低热膨胀Invar构件在航空航天工装连接中的焊接质量和电弧稳定性。
method: 熔池流动与小孔行为的数值模拟
电弧与熔池形貌演变的高速摄影
激光功率、焊接速度和电流的参数化研究
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在5-6 kW激光功率、0.5-0.8 m/min速度和150-170 A电流范围内一致的变化趋势，将工艺变化与熔深、焊缝宽度、流动强度和电弧稳定性联系起来。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Homogeneous WC–Co–Cr powder and spray process control jointly determine coating density, phase uniformity, hardness, and friction behavior.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting detonation spraying or HVOF lets engineers tune wear resistance versus surface densification for machine parts operating under high load and friction.
method: Compared WC–Co–Cr coatings made by detonation spraying and HVOF.
Used SEM and EDS to examine morphology, microstructure, and phase distribution.
Assessed tribological and mechanical performance, including microhardness and friction coefficient.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that detonation spraying produced the hardest coating (about 1449 HV), while HVOF achieved a dense, uniform coating with a low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143).
infographic.watch_item: Performance is highly sensitive to starting powder morphology and spraying conditions, so results may not transfer directly across different powder lots or process settings.
infographic.paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING

zh-Hans.title: 采用HVOF和爆炸喷涂制备的WC–CO–CR涂层结构形成与耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了比较分析。研究包括对初始粉末形貌的分析，以及利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散光谱（EDS）对涂层显微组织和相组成的分析。结果表明，采用均匀、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状结构，并使碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂获得的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度1449 HV），而HVOF制备的涂层则具有高致密性、均匀的显微组织以及较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。比较分析证实，涂层的力学和摩擦学性能高度依赖于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机器零部件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强摩擦和高载荷条件下运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: 均匀的WC–Co–Cr粉末与喷涂过程控制共同决定涂层致密性、相均匀性、硬度和摩擦行为。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 选择爆炸喷涂或HVOF可使工程师针对在高载荷和摩擦条件下运行的机器零部件调节耐磨性与表面致密化。
method: 比较了采用爆炸喷涂和HVOF制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层。
使用SEM和EDS考察形貌、显微组织和相分布。
评估了摩擦学和力学性能，包括显微硬度和摩擦系数。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告指出，爆炸喷涂获得了最硬的涂层（约1449 HV），而HVOF实现了致密、均匀的涂层，并具有较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。

title: Rupture and growth of holes in the melt pool during laser keyhole welding of thin sheets
authors: Love O. John, Alexander F.H. Kaplan
abstract: Abstract This study investigates the formation and growth of holes during laser keyhole welding of 100 μm thin 316 L stainless-steel sheets in overlap joints, represented by bead-on-plate welding of 200 μm thick foils. Using high-speed imaging, keyhole instabilities, promoted by increasing line energy, were identified as precursors to hole nucleation. Continuous weld seams were obtained up to approximately 7 kJ/m, while hole formation occurred beyond this regime and cutting became dominant above approximately 12 kJ/m. The hole growth mechanism is described by the competition between vertical and horizontal surface-tension components associated with the local melt pool curvature. Once nucleated, holes expanded at approximately 0.8–1.2 m/s over 1–3 ms and developed into elliptical shapes before forming permanent perforations or cuts. A geometric stability criterion based on the Young-Laplace force balance indicates that unstable growth occurs when the hole length becomes comparable to the sheet thickness. The thinner the foil, the stronger the vertical force component promoting hole growth, reaching 17 kN/m² here. A systematic flow chart linking the observed sequence of keyhole instability, hole nucleation, and hole growth provides a basis for identifying precursor signatures and suppressing hole formation during thin-sheet laser welding.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: In thin 316L stainless-steel foils, laser keyhole instability can trigger hole nucleation and rapid hole growth once line energy rises beyond the stable welding regime.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results define practical energy thresholds for avoiding perforation in thin-sheet laser welding and provide a geometric criterion for suppressing cut formation.
method: High-speed imaging of bead-on-plate laser welding on 200 μm foils representing 100 μm overlap-sheet joints
Systematic variation of line energy to link keyhole instability, hole nucleation, and hole growth
Geometric Young–Laplace force-balance analysis of hole shape and stability
infographic.evidence_signal: Continuous seams were achieved up to about 7 kJ/m, holes appeared above this range, and cutting dominated above about 12 kJ/m, with holes growing at roughly 0.8–1.2 m/s over 1–3 ms.
infographic.watch_item: The reported thresholds are specific to the tested foil thickness, geometry, and material, so direct transfer to other alloys or thicknesses needs validation.
infographic.paper_title: Rupture and growth of holes in the melt pool during laser keyhole welding of thin sheets

zh-Hans.title: 激光匙孔焊接薄板过程中熔池内孔洞的破裂与生长
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究考察了100 μm薄316 L不锈钢板搭接接头在激光匙孔焊接过程中孔洞的形成与生长，并以200 μm厚箔材的珠状焊（bead-on-plate）焊接作为表征对象。利用高速成像发现，随着线能量增加而被促进的匙孔不稳定性是孔洞成核的前驱征兆。约7 kJ/m以内可获得连续焊缝，而超过该范围后开始出现孔洞，在约12 kJ/m以上切割成为主导。孔洞生长机制可由与局部熔池曲率相关的垂直与水平表面张力分量之间的竞争来描述。一旦成核，孔洞在1–3 ms内以约0.8–1.2 m/s的速度扩展，并在形成永久性穿孔或切缝之前发展为椭圆形。基于Young-Laplace力平衡的几何稳定性判据表明，当孔洞长度与板厚相当时，会发生不稳定生长。箔材越薄，促进孔洞生长的垂直力分量越强，此处达到17 kN/m²。将所观察到的匙孔不稳定、孔洞成核和孔洞生长顺序系统关联的流程图，为识别前驱特征并在薄板激光焊接中抑制孔洞形成提供了基础。

infographic.key_insight: 在薄316L不锈钢箔材中，当线能量升至稳定焊接区之外时，激光匙孔不稳定性可触发孔洞成核并导致孔洞快速生长。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为避免薄板激光焊接中的穿孔界定了实用的能量阈值，并提供了抑制切缝形成的几何判据。
method: 对200 μm箔材进行珠状焊激光焊接的高速成像，该箔材用于代表100 μm搭接板接头
系统改变线能量，以关联匙孔不稳定性、孔洞成核和孔洞生长
基于几何Young–Laplace力平衡的孔洞形状与稳定性分析
infographic.evidence_signal: 连续焊缝可维持至约7 kJ/m，超过该范围后出现孔洞，约12 kJ/m以上切割占主导；孔洞在1–3 ms内以约0.8–1.2 m/s的速度生长。
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的阈值仅适用于所测试的箔材厚度、几何形状和材料，因此将其直接推广到其他合金或厚度时需要验证。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C coatings can be tuned from low-friction to high-wear-resistance behavior by adjusting barrel filling, gas ratio, and inter-shot delay.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides a practical parameter map for optimizing surface restoration and strengthening of machine parts using detonation spraying.
method: Varied barrel filling level from 48–68%.
Adjusted working-gas molar ratio (O/C = 1.026–1.856) and inter-shot delay (0–1 s).
Compared coating microstructure, roughness, hardness, friction, and wear response.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experiments showed the lowest friction at 48% filling and O/C = 1.026, while the best wear resistance occurred at O/C = 1.856 with 1 s delay, reducing specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m).
infographic.watch_item: Lower-friction settings increased wear, so the operating point must be chosen as a trade-off rather than a single-parameter optimum.
infographic.paper_title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层的方法开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 体系自熔性涂层结构以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。研究参数包括炮管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次发射间隔（0–1 s）。涂层的形貌分析表明，其具有典型的层状结构，且涂层厚度与缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的炮管填充率形成了更致密、孔隙率更低的涂层结构，而中等和较高的填充率促进了微裂纹的形成，推测这是由于残余应力增加所致。摩擦学测试表明，在炮管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得了最低摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着较高磨损。最高耐磨性出现在 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次发射间隔增至 1 s 时，此时比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，增加两次发射间隔使 Ra 从 5.00 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。最大硬度可达 905.6 HV，出现在有利于形成致密结构和强化相的参数组合下。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数需要在降低摩擦系数与提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。这些研究结果可用于开发机械部件修复和表面强化技术。

infographic.key_insight: 通过调节炮管填充率、气体比和两次发射间隔，可将爆炸喷涂的自熔性 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 涂层调控为低摩擦或高耐磨行为。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为采用爆炸喷涂优化机械零件表面修复与强化提供了实用的参数图谱。
method: 将炮管填充率从 48–68% 进行变化。
调整工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）和两次发射间隔（0–1 s）。
比较涂层的显微组织、粗糙度、硬度、摩擦和磨损响应。

title: THE EFFECT OF THE COMPOSITION OF METAL-CERAMIC POWDERS ON THE STRUCTURE AND PERFORMANCE PROPERTIES OF COATINGS OBTAINED BY THE HVOF METHOD
authors: Yermakhan Molbossynov, Arystanbek Kussainov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Indira Abizhanova, Rashid Kuanyshbay, Abai Alimov
abstract: The article presents the results of a comprehensive study of WC–Co–Cr, WC–NiCr, WC–Ni, Cr₃C₂–NiCr, and Al₂O₃–NiCr cermet coatings deposited onto a 65G steel substrate by the high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spraying method. An analysis of the microstructure (SEM/EDS), microhardness, surface roughness, tribological characteristics, and adhesive strength of the coatings was carried out. It was established that the composition of the powder mixture and the characteristics of the binder phase significantly affect the formation of the structure and performance properties of the coatings. The WC–Co–Cr coating formed the densest and most structurally homogeneous lamellar structure, demonstrating the lowest coefficient of friction (μ = 0.143), the highest microhardness (1316.87 HV), and high resistance to scratch loading. The Cr₃C₂–NiCr and WC–NiCr coatings showed satisfactory tribological characteristics (μ = 0.310 and 0.326, respectively); however, reduced adhesive strength was observed for the Cr₃C₂–NiCr coating. The WC–Ni coating was characterized by an increased coefficient of friction (0.545) at moderate hardness values (721.2 HV). The highest coefficient of friction was found for the Al₂O₃–NiCr coating (0.630), while this system also demonstrated the lowest microhardness (631.59 HV) and instability in structure formation. The surface roughness of the coatings was in the range of Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm and depended on the spraying conditions. The obtained results made it possible to determine that the WC–Co–Cr coating provides the optimal combination of mechanical and tribological properties and is the most promising for application under conditions of intensive abrasive-adhesive wear in mechanical engineering, power engineering, and metallurgy.

infographic.key_insight: Among five HVOF-sprayed cermet coatings on 65G steel, WC–Co–Cr delivered the best overall balance of densest microstructure, highest hardness, and lowest friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-critical machine components, the WC–Co–Cr system appears to be the strongest candidate when both abrasive-adhesive resistance and coating integrity matter.

zh-Hans.title: 金属-陶瓷粉末组成对HVOF法制备涂层结构及性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积在65G钢基体上的WC–Co–Cr、WC–NiCr、WC–Ni、Cr₃C₂–NiCr和Al₂O₃–NiCr金属陶瓷涂层进行了系统研究。分析了涂层的显微组织（SEM/EDS）、显微硬度、表面粗糙度、摩擦学特性以及黏附强度。结果表明，粉末混合物的组成以及黏结相的特性对涂层结构形成和服役性能具有显著影响。WC–Co–Cr涂层形成了最致密、结构最均匀的层状组织，表现出最低的摩擦系数（μ = 0.143）、最高的显微硬度（1316.87 HV）以及较高的抗划痕载荷能力。Cr₃C₂–NiCr和WC–NiCr涂层表现出令人满意的摩擦学特性（分别为μ = 0.310和0.326）；然而，Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的黏附强度有所降低。WC–Ni涂层在中等硬度值（721.2 HV）下表现出较高的摩擦系数（0.545）。Al₂O₃–NiCr涂层的摩擦系数最高（0.630），同时该体系还表现出最低的显微硬度（631.59 HV）和结构形成的不稳定性。涂层表面粗糙度范围为Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm，并受喷涂条件影响。所得结果表明，WC–Co–Cr涂层兼具最佳的力学与摩擦学性能组合，是机械工程、动力工程和冶金领域中承受强烈磨粒-黏着磨损工况时最具应用前景的涂层。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: For welding property prediction, stacking ensemble learning achieved higher task-wise accuracy than a multitask neural network, while MTNN still demonstrated strong shared-task generalization.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps engineers choose between a shared-model approach for related outputs and a high-accuracy ensemble when predicting UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness in welding processes.

zh-Hans.title: 焊接应用中用于预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和HAZ机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其设计目标是由一个模型同时处理多个相互关联的任务。与分别为每个任务训练独立模型不同，MTL在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。在本研究中，我们基于共享数据集，对两种先进机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，在预测这些参数方面进行了比较。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一种特定类型的多任务学习（MTL）模型，它使用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用RMSE和R^2进行评估，以确定其预测精度和总体有效性。结果表明，该方法具有较强的预测能力，其RMSE分别为UTS的0.1288、焊缝硬度的0.0886以及HAZ硬度的0.1125，而R^2值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明其在相互关联任务中具有良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在单项任务精度方面优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263、R^2为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467、R^2为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109、R^2为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法具有生成高精度、任务特定预测的良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；而堆叠集成在需要高精度、独立预测的情况下表现更佳。在这两种情况下，它们都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，并适合作为进一步研究混合模型的前导，以结合两种方法的最佳特性。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings form dense fine-lamellar microstructures when droplets spread well, and this improves long-term corrosion and wear performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spraying parameters and humidity exposure can help extend the service life of Fe-based protective coatings on carbon steel.
method: Fe-based amorphous coatings deposited on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implants must be designed as coupled biomechanical–biomaterial systems, where geometry, graded coatings, and fixation performance jointly determine load transfer and osseointegration.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The review informs implant designers and translational engineers on how finite element gait loading, functionally graded Ti-HAp interfaces, and coating durability can be used to reduce micromotion and improve long-term distal support.

infographic.watch_item: Graded Ti-HAp and FGM claims are supported mainly by non-DWBI analog studies, so device-level validation under patient-realistic gait loading and coating-fatigue conditions is still needed.

zh-Hans.title: 远端负重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端负重植入物（DWBIs）代表一类临床上新兴的承重医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面架构与生物力学性能紧密耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨经骨式康复中恢复远端支撑的能力，还取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变骨-植入物界面的弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、结合步态阶段载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。我们对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度和转化准备度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床研究构成了较小的验证层级。以HAp为中心的表面或体材料工程在文献中占据了相当比例；然而，关于梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料和机理类比研究，支持的是机理上的可行性，而非DWBI特异性验证。从机理上讲，DWBI应被理解为一个整合的生物材料-力学系统，连接宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面架构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态阶段载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程。其转化将要求采用更贴近患者真实的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析工作流程、器械级疲劳与涂层完整性测试、标准化体内终点、协调一致的康复方案，以及由注册数据库支持的临床随访，以将力学可行性与持久的生物学固定及患者获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端负重植入物必须作为耦合的生物力学-生物材料系统进行设计，其中几何形态、梯度涂层和固定性能共同决定载荷传递与骨整合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本综述为植入物设计者和转化工程师提供参考，说明如何利用有限元步态载荷、功能梯度Ti-HAp界面以及涂层耐久性来降低微动并改善长期远端支撑。
method: 对DWBI概念、生物材料界面和临床转化路径进行系统综述
对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行定量趋势分析
综合有限元、体内骨整合和梯度材料证据
infographic.evidence_signal: 现有证据基础仍处于早期阶段：超过一半的实证研究仅限于台架或仿真，动物和临床验证所占比例较小。
infographic.watch_item: 梯度Ti-HAp和FGM的相关主张主要由非DWBI类比研究支持，因此仍需要在患者真实步态载荷和涂层疲劳条件下进行器械级验证。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed joint geometry combined with optimized direct drive friction welding parameters substantially improves AA2024-T351 joint strength, while deep learning can predict weld performance from process settings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical route to stronger lightweight aerospace/automotive aluminum joints by pairing geometry-driven mechanical interlocking with data-driven process optimization.
method: Designed DDFW experiments with an L18 orthogonal array across friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying-surface geometry, and friction time.
Tested a novel drilled-to-bossed geometry against conventional flat-to-flat joints to improve interlocking and weld integrity.
Trained deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, compact attention network, and adaptive multiscale network, to predict ultimate tensile strength.
infographic.evidence_signal: The best setting achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength, and the top predictor reached an R² of about 0.81.
infographic.watch_item: The predictive model performance is moderate rather than near-perfect, so broader validation on more data and conditions would be needed before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔凸台几何与直接驱动摩擦焊中的深度学习预测提升 AA2024-T351 的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 对轻量化、高强度材料在航空航天和汽车工业中的需求不断增长，使得 AA2024-T351 等铝合金因其优异的比强度而备受关注。然而，在这类合金中获得可靠接头仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化 AA2024-T351 直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，提出一种新颖的钻孔凸台几何形状，以增强机械互锁并提高焊接完整性。采用 L18 正交阵列系统设计实验，评估拉伸强度和扭转强度。实验在一台定制车床上进行，摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间被选为可控工艺参数。与此同时，实施了包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在内的先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限拉伸强度。结果表明，30 MPa 摩擦压力、70 MPa 镦粗压力、2200 rpm 主轴转速、钻孔凸台几何形状以及 4 min 摩擦时间的最优参数组合表现出卓越的力学性能，拉伸强度达到 538 MPa，扭转强度达到 325 MPa。与传统平面对平面接头相比，钻孔凸台结构表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高预测精度，R² 值约为 0.81，能够有效捕捉工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 将钻孔凸台接头几何与优化后的直接驱动摩擦焊参数相结合，可显著提高 AA2024-T351 接头强度，同时深度学习能够根据工艺参数预测焊接性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为更强韧的轻量化航空航天/汽车铝合金接头提供了一条实用路径，通过几何驱动的机械互锁与数据驱动的工艺优化相结合实现性能提升。
method: 采用 L18 正交阵列设计 DDFW 实验，考察摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间。
将新型钻孔凸台几何与传统平面对平面接头进行对比，以增强互锁并提高焊接完整性。
训练包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在内的深度学习模型，以预测极限拉伸强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 最佳参数下拉伸强度达到 538 MPa、扭转强度达到 325 MPa，而表现最好的预测模型 R² 约为 0.81。
infographic.watch_item: 预测模型性能属于中等水平而非接近完美，因此在部署前仍需在更多数据和条件下进行更广泛的验证。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation spraying conditions can be tuned to control titanium-based coating roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity, with clear process-structure-property relationships identified.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide practical parameter guidance for optimizing coating surfaces in applications that require improved water repellency and predictable surface finish.
method: Varied detonation spraying process parameters, especially nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Measured coating surface roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity via contact angle.
Derived empirical equations linking surface characteristics to process conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports parameter-dependent trends and fitted laws, including inverse power and parabolic relationships, used to determine optimal spraying conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
infographic.watch_item: The findings appear to be based on empirical process correlations, so transferability to different materials, substrates, or spray systems may require revalidation.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂在各种工艺条件下获得的钛基涂层表面特征
zh-Hans.abstract: 描述了基于二氧化钛的金属-陶瓷涂层表面性能随爆炸喷涂条件变化而呈现的规律。研究发现，表面粗糙度、表面厚度及其疏水性等特性可在生产过程中通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定取值加以控制。确定了爆炸喷涂工艺参数的最优值，可确保所制备涂层具有最大的疏水性。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间符合反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角与喷涂距离之间符合抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特征，并确定涂层喷涂的最佳工况，从而保证其最佳疏水性。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂条件可调控钛基涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性，并已识别出清晰的工艺-结构-性能关系。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为优化需要提高拒水性和可预测表面状态的应用中的涂层表面提供了实用的参数指导。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂工艺参数，尤其是喷嘴通过速度和喷涂距离。
通过接触角测量涂层表面粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
推导将表面特征与工艺条件联系起来的经验方程。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报道了参数依赖趋势和拟合规律，包括反幂和抛物线关系，并据此确定了实现最大疏水性的最佳喷涂条件。
infographic.watch_item: 这些发现似乎基于经验性的工艺相关关系，因此在不同材料、基体或喷涂系统中的适用性可能需要重新验证。
